fields.title: LinkedIn event attendee record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of LinkedIn event data. One EVENT row per event, one ATTENDEE row per person, NOTICE rows when no cookie was supplied or LinkedIn withheld the roster, and ERROR rows on failure. LinkedIn changes its private API without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The event URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source surface
_source.description: voyager-event, voyager-event-attendees, or none on NOTICE and ERROR rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: unparsable_event, auth_required, fetch_failed or attendees_failed.

_notice.title: Notice
_notice.description: cookie_required when no li_at was supplied, attendee_list_withheld when LinkedIn served the event but not its roster.

_noticeDetail.title: Notice detail
_noticeDetail.description: What the notice means and what to change.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.description: The attendee's display name as LinkedIn renders it.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: Split from the display name with pronouns, emoji hiring frames and credential suffixes removed, so a mail merge reads correctly.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Last remaining name part after the same cleanup. Null for mononyms.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The attendee's LinkedIn headline - what they do, in their own words.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Canonical profile link, tracking parameters stripped and country subdomains folded onto www so a CRM de-duplicates correctly.

attendanceStatus.title: Attendance status
attendanceStatus.description: Whether the person registered or attended, when LinkedIn distinguishes them.

eventDescription.title: Event description
eventDescription.description: EVENT rows: the event blurb, trimmed to 2,000 characters.

eventOrganiser.title: Organiser
eventOrganiser.description: The person or company running the event - often a lead in its own right.

eventAttendeeCount.title: Attendee count
eventAttendeeCount.description: How many people LinkedIn says are attending. This is frequently published even when the NAMES are withheld, so compare it against your row count to see how much of the roster you actually received.

eventStartAtEpochMs.title: Starts at
eventStartAtEpochMs.description: EVENT rows: start time as epoch milliseconds.
